Table rules
Rules for the whole table. Players see the result, not these switches.
Paint the light with the map tools (Light tab); turn the Light layer on to see it. Spells add their own light (Light, Continual Flame, Dancing Lights, Daylight, Moonbeam, Faerie Fire, Produce Flame, Flame Blade), and Darkness and Hunger of Hadar make magical darkness that Darkvision can't see through. An effect named Torch, Lantern or Candle on a token makes it carry light.

DM: Scenes and saving

Scene files

A scene is one map with its grid, fog and creatures. Loading a scene swaps those and keeps your party.

Scene library (saved inside the campaign and every backup)

Scene files hold one scene with its map picture, creatures, walls, fog and ground items, so they can be kept, shared or added to another campaign. With a DM folder they are saved in its scenes folder; otherwise they are downloaded. The scene name box above names the scene. Map pictures of stored scenes are written once to the backup folder's scene-maps folder, so the folder holds the maps not in use; the map in use is campaign-table-map.json.

Whole campaign backup

The table saves itself in this browser. A backup file holds everything, party included, for safekeeping or another computer.

Automatic backups

The list above is kept inside this browser (not on the players' screens): it survives a crash but not clearing the browser's site data. The backup folder is a real folder on this computer and is not affected by that.
